title: When the Message Disappears from the Readout
question: Under which finite CA rules do 16 messages remain distinguishable at a fixed downstream sensor?
method: Reconciliation of two frozen differently implemented deterministic CA histories; independent stored-transition rule audit.
finding: Across the tested widths/windows, Rules 90, 26, 122 yield 16 distinct readouts and Rule 74 yields the same empty readout for all 16.
claim_scope: Finite codebook and sensor-window behavior only, not physical information destruction or quantum tunneling.
limitations: The full primary archives and audit directory are not included; this is a bounded finite result.
open_questions: What additional conclusions, if any, would the original missing evidence support?
